title: Tidio Review (2026)
intro: Tidio is evaluated here as a live chat and website messenger support platform — Tidio is a live chat and AI messaging platform for website visitor support and conversation automation. Reconciled from CRM-primary to customer-service live-chat primary. Annual pricing: Starter $24.17/mo for 100 billable conversations; Growth from $49.17/mo annual. Lyro AI agent and flows for deflection. Not a sales CRM — scored in live-chat-support cluster only. This review uses SoftwareGlimpse's customer-service methodology (ease of use, support job fit, workflow depth, omnichannel, self-service, integrations, analytics, scalability, value, AI), scoring products inside their job cluster rather than against unrelated peers. It is based on first-party research, not hands-on lab testing.
summary: Choose Tidio when live chat and AI visitor deflection on your website is the primary job — not when you need enterprise ticketing or CRM pipeline management.
verdict: Choose Tidio when live chat and AI visitor deflection on your website is the primary job — not when you need enterprise ticketing or CRM pipeline management. Compare Freshchat and LiveChat for per-agent live-chat packaging with Freshworks or Text ecosystem depth. Scores reflect first-party documentation as of 2026-08-18 — not hands-on product testing. Confirm current packaging, minimums and usage rates on the vendor site before purchase.
